first_record ;

message('Working...') ; --pitss synchronize ;
for i in 0..no_of_days loop
 curday := to_char(:s_from_date + i ,'DY') ;
 if (curday = 'MON' and mon = 'Y') or

 (curday = 'SUN' and sun = 'Y') then

 v_to_time := mon_to_time ;
 elsif curday = 'TUE' then

 v_to_time := tue_to_time ;
 elsif curday = 'WED' then
 v_from_time := wed_from_time ;
 v_to_time := wed_to_time ;
 elsif curday = 'THU' then

 v_to_time := thu_to_time ;

 v_to_time := fri_to_time ;
 elsif curday = 'SAT' then
 v_from_time := sat_from_time ;
 v_to_time := sat_to_time ;
 elsif curday = 'SUN' then

 v_to_time := sun_to_time ;
 end if ;
 :control_block.select_day := 'Y';
 :staff_off_day.staff_no := :control_block.s_staff_no ;
 :staff_off_day.unavail_date := :s_from_date + i ;
 :staff_off_day.reason := :by_day.s_reason_code ;
 :staff_off_day.reason_desc := :by_day.s_reason_desc ;
 :staff_off_day.assignment_type := :by_day.s_assignment_type ;
 if v_from_time is not null then

 :staff_off_day.to_time := to_date(to_char(:unavail_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||v_to_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI') ;

 end if ;
 :unavail_day := to_char(:unavail_date,'DY') ;
 next_record ;
 count_rec := count_rec + 1 ;
 end if ;
end loop ;
clear_message ;

if count_rec = 0 then

 check_package_failure ;
else
 disable_control_block ;
 clear_record ;
 first_record ;
 :control_block.select_day := 'N';
 :control_block.day_block := 'N' ;
end if ;
end ;
